cases.grounding: regression_scanner.py flagged the removed except line in engine/core.py's hunk; target_resolver.py confirmed fan_in=8, is_hotspot=True.

cases.description: engine/util2.py's change is genuinely low risk: only a trailing comment was added, no diff-pattern flags fired, structural fan_in=0, and it is covered by tests/test_util2.py -- this file should not be lumped in with the diff's two high-risk files.
cases.grounding: regression_scanner.py found zero flags for engine/util2.py's hunk; risk_scorer.py returned overall_risk_tier='low'.

cases.description: Of the three changed files, two (engine/core.py, engine/helper.py) land at HIGH overall risk and one (engine/util2.py) stays LOW -- the diff as a whole should not be reviewed as uniformly risky or uniformly safe; each file's tier traces to its own combination of flags, structural tier, and coverage.
